````text
//! Px-Noise-Final: Pipeline Cascata Otimizada com Early-Exit e SIMD
//! 
//! Implementa análise em cascata com métricas N1-N8, amostragem adaptativa
//! e otimizações SIMD para máxima eficiência.
use serde::{Deserialize, Serialize};
use std::collections::HashMap;
use std::time::{Duration, Instant};
use parking_lot::RwLock;
use wide::f32x8;
use lz4_flex;
use goertzel::GoertzelFilter;
#[derive(Debug, Clone, Serialize, Deserialize)]
pub struct NoiseFinalConfig {
    pub enable_simd: bool,
    pub window_size_kb: usize,
    pub overlap_percent: u8,
    pub fpr_target: f64,
    pub early_exit_threshold: f64,
    pub adaptive_sampling: bool,
    pub cascade_mode: CascadeMode,
}
#[derive(Debug, Clone, Serialize, Deserialize)]
pub enum CascadeMode {
    Eco,          // Máximo throughput - N2+N3+N5, early-exit agressivo
    Balanced,     // Default - N2+N3+N5 → N6 → N4; N1 rápido se incerto
    Fidelity,     // Inspeção completa - todos os tiers com amostragem
}
impl Default for NoiseFinalConfig {
    fn default() -> Self {
        Self {
            enable_simd: true,
            window_size_kb: 4,
            overlap_percent: 75,
            fpr_target: 0.05,
            early_exit_threshold: 0.8,
            adaptive_sampling: true,
            cascade_mode: CascadeMode::Balanced,
        }
    }
}
/// Sistema de métricas N1-N8 completas
#[derive(Debug, Clone, Serialize, Deserialize)]
pub struct NoiseMetrics {
    pub n1_compression: f32,     // LZ4/Zstd ratio
    pub n2_entropy: f32,         // Shannon entropy rolling
    pub n3_lz_complexity: f32,   // Lempel-Ziv complexity hint
    pub n4_syndrome: f32,        // Error correction syndromes  
    pub n5_format: f32,          // Format signature distance
    pub n6_spectral: f32,        // Spectral flatness via Goertzel
    pub n7_autocorr: f32,        // Autocorrelation peak/noise ratio
    pub n8_coherence: f32,       // Inter-channel coherence
    pub aggregate: f32,          // Median robust dos metrics válidos
    pub computed_mask: u8,       // Bitmask das métricas computadas
    pub tier_reached: u8,        // Último tier executado (1-3)
}
impl Default for NoiseMetrics {
    fn default() -> Self {
        Self {
            n1_compression: 0.0,
            n2_entropy: 0.0,
            n3_lz_complexity: 0.0,
            n4_syndrome: 0.0,
            n5_format: 0.0,
            n6_spectral: 0.0,
            n7_autocorr: 0.0,
            n8_coherence: 0.0,
            aggregate: 0.0,
            computed_mask: 0,
            tier_reached: 0,
        }
    }
}
/// Resultado completo da análise cascata
#[derive(Debug, Clone)]
pub struct NoiseAnalysisResult {
    pub metrics: NoiseMetrics,
    pub decision: NoiseDecision,
    pub segments: Vec<NoiseSegment>,
    pub early_exit: bool,
    pub performance_stats: PerformanceStats,
}
#[derive(Debug, Clone)]
pub struct NoiseSegment {
    pub start: usize,
    pub end: usize,
    pub classification: SegmentClass,
    pub confidence: f32,
    pub noise_score: f32,
}
#[derive(Debug, Clone, PartialEq)]
pub enum SegmentClass {
    Signal,      // Estrutura detectada
    Noise,       // Ruído confirmado  
    Ambiguous,   // Zona limítrofe
}
#[derive(Debug, Clone)]
pub enum NoiseDecision {
    Fast(String),    // Route para processamento rápido
    Deep(String),    // Route para análise aprofundada
}
#[derive(Debug, Clone)]
pub struct PerformanceStats {
    pub total_time_us: u64,
    pub bytes_processed: usize,
    pub throughput_mb_s: f64,
    pub simd_used: bool,
    pub early_exits: u32,
}
/// Motor principal do sistema Noise-Final
#[derive(Debug)]
pub struct NoiseFinalEngine {
    config: NoiseFinalConfig,
    entropy_state: RollingEntropy,
    lz_state: LzHintState,
    format_sigs: HashMap<&'static str, Vec<u8>>,
    adaptive_thresholds: AdaptiveThresholds,
    goertzel_banks: Vec<GoertzelFilter>,
    performance_cache: RwLock<PerformanceCache>,
}
/// Estado rolling para entropia O(1)
#[derive(Debug)]
struct RollingEntropy {
    window_size: usize,
    byte_counts: [u32; 256],
    total_bytes: u32,
    entropy_cache: f32,
    cache_valid: bool,
}
impl RollingEntropy {
    fn new(window_size: usize) -> Self {
        Self {
            window_size,
            byte_counts: [0; 256],
            total_bytes: 0,
            entropy_cache: 0.0,
            cache_valid: false,
        }
    }
    fn update(&mut self, byte: u8) {
        self.byte_counts[byte as usize] += 1;
        self.total_bytes += 1;
        self.cache_valid = false;
        // Sliding window - remove oldest if window exceeded
        if self.total_bytes > self.window_size as u32 {
            // Implementação simplificada - em produção usar buffer circular
            let excess = self.total_bytes - self.window_size as u32;
            self.total_bytes = self.window_size as u32;
            // Atualizar counts removendo bytes antigos
        }
    }
    fn entropy(&mut self) -> f32 {
        if self.cache_valid {
            return self.entropy_cache;
        }
        if self.total_bytes == 0 {
            return 0.0;
        }
        let mut entropy = 0.0f32;
        let total = self.total_bytes as f32;
        for &count in &self.byte_counts {
            if count > 0 {
                let p = count as f32 / total;
                entropy -= p * p.log2();
            }
        }
        self.entropy_cache = entropy / 8.0; // Normalizar para [0,1]
        self.cache_valid = true;
        self.entropy_cache
    }
    fn reset(&mut self) {
        self.byte_counts = [0; 256];
        self.total_bytes = 0;
        self.cache_valid = false;
    }
}
````

````text
```rust
//! Zero XAI - Sistema Operativo Cognitivo Completo
//! Implementação com Módulos Px Avançados em Rust para Windows x86_64


use axum::{
    routing::{get, post},
    Router,
    http::StatusCode,
    response::Json,
};
use serde_json::{json, Value};
use std::sync::Arc;
use tokio::signal;
use tower::ServiceBuilder;
use tower_http::{cors::CorsLayer, fs::ServeDir};
use tracing::{info, error};
use tracing_subscriber;


mod core;
mod px;
mod api; 
mod utils;


use crate::core::state::AppState;


#[tokio::main]
async fn main() -> Result<(), Box<dyn std::error::Error>> {
    // Configurar logging
    tracing_subscriber::fmt()
        .with_target(false)
        .compact() 
        .init();


    info!("🚀 Iniciando Zero XAI v3.0 - Sistema Operativo Cognitivo");


    // Inicializar estado da aplicação
    let app_state = Arc::new(AppState::new().await?);
    info!("✅ Estado da aplicação inicializado");


    // Configurar rotas
    let app = Router::new()
        .route("/", get(|| async { "Zero XAI v3.0 - Sistema Operativo Cognitivo" }))
        .route("/health", get(health_check))
        .nest("/api/v1", api::routes())
        .nest("/api/v1/px", api::px_handlers::routes())
        .nest_service("/static", ServeDir::new("static"))
        .layer(
            ServiceBuilder::new()
                .layer(CorsLayer::permissive())
        )
        .with_state(app_state);


    // Iniciar servidor
    let listener = tokio::net::TcpListener::bind("127.0.0.1:3000").await?;
    info!("🌐 Servidor rodando em http://127.0.0.1:3000");


    axum::serve(listener, app)
        .with_graceful_shutdown(shutdown_signal())
        .await?;


    Ok(())
}


async fn health_check() -> Result<Json<Value>, StatusCode> {
    Ok(Json(json!({
        "status": "healthy",
        "version": "3.0.0",
        "timestamp": chrono::Utc::now(),
        "modules": {
            "px_noise_final": true,
            "px_reality": true, 
            "px_prisma": true,
            "px_memory_pack": true,
            "px_gen": true
        }
    })))
}


async fn shutdown_signal() {
    let ctrl_c = async {
        signal::ctrl_c()
            .await
            .expect("Falha ao instalar handler Ctrl+C");
    };


    #[cfg(unix)]
    let terminate = async {
        signal::unix::signal(signal::unix::SignalKind::terminate())
            .expect("Falha ao instalar handler SIGTERM")
            .recv()
            .await;
    };


    #[cfg(not(unix))]
    let terminate = std::future::pending::<()>();


    tokio::select! {
        _ = ctrl_c => {},
        _ = terminate => {},
    }


    info!("🛑 Sinal de shutdown recebido, finalizando...");
}
```

//! Estado global da aplicação Zero XAI com módulos Px


use std::sync::{Arc, Mutex};
use crate::px::{
    noise_final::{NoiseFinalEngine, NoiseFinalConfig},
    reality::{RealityEngine, RealityConfig, RealityContract},
    prisma::{PrismaEngine, PrismaConfig},
    memory_pack::{MemPackEngine, MemPackConfig},
    gen::{GenerativeEngine, GenerativeConfig},
};
use crate::core::error::ZeroXaiError;


/// Estado principal da aplicação Zero XAI
#[derive(Debug)]
pub struct AppState {
    pub px_modules: PxModules,
    pub config: SystemConfig,
    pub metrics: Arc<Mutex<SystemMetrics>>,
}


#[derive(Debug)]
pub struct PxModules {
    pub noise_final: Arc<Mutex<NoiseFinalEngine>>,
    pub reality: Arc<Mutex<RealityEngine>>,
    pub prisma: Arc<Mutex<PrismaEngine>>,
    pub memory_pack: Arc<Mutex<MemPackEngine>>,
    pub gen: Arc<Mutex<GenerativeEngine>>,
}


#[derive(Debug, Clone)]
pub struct SystemConfig {
    pub environment: String,
    pub log_level: String,
    pub max_connections: usize,
    pub px_enabled: bool,
}


impl Default for SystemConfig {
    fn default() -> Self {
        Self {
            environment: "development".to_string(),
            log_level: "info".to_string(),
            max_connections: 1000,
            px_enabled: true,
        }
    }
}


#[derive(Debug, Clone)]
pub struct SystemMetrics {
    pub uptime_seconds: u64,
    pub requests_processed: u64,
    pub px_noise_analyses: u64,
    pub px_reality_checks: u64,
    pub px_prisma_decompositions: u64,
    pub px_mempack_searches: u64,
    pub px_generations: u64,
    pub last_updated: chrono::DateTime<chrono::Utc>,
}


impl Default for SystemMetrics {
    fn default() -> Self {
        Self {
            uptime_seconds: 0,
            requests_processed: 0,
            px_noise_analyses: 0,
            px_reality_checks: 0,
            px_prisma_decompositions: 0,
            px_mempack_searches: 0,
            px_generations: 0,
            last_updated: chrono::Utc::now(),
        }
    }
}


impl AppState {
    pub async fn new() -> Result<Self, ZeroXaiError> {
        let config = SystemConfig::default();
        
        // Inicializar módulos Px
        let px_modules = PxModules::new().await?;
        
        let metrics = Arc::new(Mutex::new(SystemMetrics::default()));


        Ok(Self {
            px_modules,
            config,
            metrics,
        })
    }


    pub fn increment_requests(&self) {
        if let Ok(mut metrics) = self.metrics.lock() {
            metrics.requests_processed += 1;
            metrics.last_updated = chrono::Utc::now();
        }
    }


    pub fn increment_px_noise_analyses(&self) {
        if let Ok(mut metrics) = self.metrics.lock() {
            metrics.px_noise_analyses += 1;
        }
    }


    pub fn increment_px_reality_checks(&self) {
        if let Ok(mut metrics) = self.metrics.lock() {
            metrics.px_reality_checks += 1;
        }
    }


    pub fn increment_px_prisma_decompositions(&self) {
        if let Ok(mut metrics) = self.metrics.lock() {
            metrics.px_prisma_decompositions += 1;
        }
    }


    pub fn increment_px_mempack_searches(&self) {
        if let Ok(mut metrics) = self.metrics.lock() {
            metrics.px_mempack_searches += 1;
        }
    }


    pub fn increment_px_generations(&self) {
        if let Ok(mut metrics) = self.metrics.lock() {
            metrics.px_generations += 1;
        }
    }
}


impl PxModules {
    pub async fn new() -> Result<Self, ZeroXaiError> {
        // Configurações padrão
        let noise_config = NoiseFinalConfig::default();
        let reality_config = RealityConfig::default();
        let prisma_config = PrismaConfig::default();
        let mempack_config = MemPackConfig::default();
        let gen_config = GenerativeConfig::default();


        // Criar contrato de realidade básico
        let reality_contract = RealityContract {
            schema_version: 1,
            device_id: "windows-x86_64-dev".to_string(),
            congenic_sensors: Vec::new(),
            allowed_transforms: vec!["linear_correction".to_string()],
            signature: None,
        };


        Ok(Self {
            noise_final: Arc::new(Mutex::new(NoiseFinalEngine::new(noise_config))),
            reality: Arc::new(Mutex::new(RealityEngine::new(reality_config, reality_contract)?)),
            prisma: Arc::new(Mutex::new(PrismaEngine::new(prisma_config))),
            memory_pack: Arc::new(Mutex::new(MemPackEngine::new(mempack_config)?)),
            gen: Arc::new(Mutex::new(GenerativeEngine::new(gen_config)?)),
        })
    }
}

//! Tipos de erro para Zero XAI


use axum::{
    http::StatusCode,
    response::{IntoResponse, Response},
    Json,
};
use serde_json::json;


#[derive(thiserror::Error, Debug)]
pub enum ZeroXaiError {
    #[error("Erro de configuração: {0}")]
    Config(String),
    
    #[error("Erro de inicialização do módulo Px: {0}")]
    PxModuleInit(String),
    
    #[error("Erro de análise de ruído: {0}")]
    NoiseAnalysis(String),
    
    #[error("Erro de verificação de realidade: {0}")]
    RealityCheck(String),
    
    #[error("Erro de decomposição prismática: {0}")]
    PrismaDecomposition(String),
    
    #[error("Erro do MemPack: {0}")]
    MemPack(String),
    
    #[error("Erro de geração: {0}")]
    Generation(String),
    
    #[error("Erro interno: {0}")]
    Internal(String),
    
    #[error("Recurso não encontrado: {0}")]
    NotFound(String),
    
    #[error("Parâmetros inválidos: {0}")]
    InvalidParameters(String),
    
    #[error("Erro de I/O: {0}")]
    Io(#[from] std::io::Error),
    
    #[error("Erro de serialização: {0}")]
    Serialization(#[from] serde_json::Error),
}


impl IntoResponse for ZeroXaiError {
    fn into_response(self) -> Response {
        let (status, error_message) = match self {
            ZeroXaiError::Config(_) => (StatusCode::INTERNAL_SERVER_ERROR, self.to_string()),
            ZeroXaiError::PxModuleInit(_) => (StatusCode::INTERNAL_SERVER_ERROR, self.to_string()),
            ZeroXaiError::NoiseAnalysis(_) => (StatusCode::BAD_REQUEST, self.to_string()),
            ZeroXaiError::RealityCheck(_) => (StatusCode::BAD_REQUEST, self.to_string()),
            ZeroXaiError::PrismaDecomposition(_) => (StatusCode::BAD_REQUEST, self.to_string()),
            ZeroXaiError::MemPack(_) => (StatusCode::INTERNAL_SERVER_ERROR, self.to_string()),
            ZeroXaiError::Generation(_) => (StatusCode::BAD_REQUEST, self.to_string()),
            ZeroXaiError::Internal(_) => (StatusCode::INTERNAL_SERVER_ERROR, self.to_string()),
            ZeroXaiError::NotFound(_) => (StatusCode::NOT_FOUND, self.to_string()),
            ZeroXaiError::InvalidParameters(_) => (StatusCode::BAD_REQUEST, self.to_string()),
            ZeroXaiError::Io(_) => (StatusCode::INTERNAL_SERVER_ERROR, self.to_string()),
            ZeroXaiError::Serialization(_) => (StatusCode::BAD_REQUEST, self.to_string()),
        };


        let body = Json(json!({
            "error": error_message,
            "timestamp": chrono::Utc::now()
        }));


        (status, body).into_response()
    }
}

//! Px-Noise-Final: Pipeline Cascata Otimizada com Early-Exit e SIMD
//! 
//! Implementa análise em cascata com métricas N1-N8, amostragem adaptativa
//! e otimizações SIMD para máxima eficiência.


use serde::{Deserialize, Serialize};
use std::collections::HashMap;
use std::time::{Duration, Instant};
use parking_lot::RwLock;
use wide::f32x8;
use lz4_flex;
use goertzel::GoertzelFilter;


#[derive(Debug, Clone, Serialize, Deserialize)]
pub struct NoiseFinalConfig {
    pub enable_simd: bool,
    pub window_size_kb: usize,
    pub overlap_percent: u8,
    pub fpr_target: f64,
    pub early_exit_threshold: f64,
    pub adaptive_sampling: bool,
    pub cascade_mode: CascadeMode,
}


#[derive(Debug, Clone, Serialize, Deserialize)]
pub enum CascadeMode {
    Eco,          // Máximo throughput - N2+N3+N5, early-exit agressivo
    Balanced,     // Default - N2+N3+N5 → N6 → N4; N1 rápido se incerto
    Fidelity,     // Inspeção completa - todos os tiers com amostragem
}


impl Default for NoiseFinalConfig {
    fn default() -> Self {
        Self {
            enable_simd: true,
            window_size_kb: 4,
            overlap_percent: 75,
            fpr_target: 0.05,
            early_exit_threshold: 0.8,
            adaptive_sampling: true,
            cascade_mode: CascadeMode::Balanced,
        }
    }
}


/// Sistema de métricas N1-N8 completas
#[derive(Debug, Clone, Serialize, Deserialize)]
pub struct NoiseMetrics {
    pub n1_compression: f32,     // LZ4/Zstd ratio
    pub n2_entropy: f32,         // Shannon entropy rolling
    pub n3_lz_complexity: f32,   // Lempel-Ziv complexity hint
    pub n4_syndrome: f32,        // Error correction syndromes  
    pub n5_format: f32,          // Format signature distance
    pub n6_spectral: f32,        // Spectral flatness via Goertzel
    pub n7_autocorr: f32,        // Autocorrelation peak/noise ratio
    pub n8_coherence: f32,       // Inter-channel coherence
    pub aggregate: f32,          // Median robust dos metrics válidos
    pub computed_mask: u8,       // Bitmask das métricas computadas
    pub tier_reached: u8,        // Último tier executado (1-3)
}


impl Default for NoiseMetrics {
    fn default() -> Self {
        Self {
            n1_compression: 0.0,
            n2_entropy: 0.0,
            n3_lz_complexity: 0.0,
            n4_syndrome: 0.0,
            n5_format: 0.0,
            n6_spectral: 0.0,
            n7_autocorr: 0.0,
            n8_coherence: 0.0,
            aggregate: 0.0,
            computed_mask: 0,
            tier_reached: 0,
        }
    }
}


/// Resultado completo da análise cascata
#[derive(Debug, Clone)]
pub struct NoiseAnalysisResult {
    pub metrics: NoiseMetrics,
    pub decision: NoiseDecision,
    pub segments: Vec<NoiseSegment>,
    pub early_exit: bool,
    pub performance_stats: PerformanceStats,
}


#[derive(Debug, Clone)]
pub struct NoiseSegment {
    pub start: usize,
    pub end: usize,
    pub classification: SegmentClass,
    pub confidence: f32,
    pub noise_score: f32,
}


#[derive(Debug, Clone, PartialEq)]
pub enum SegmentClass {
    Signal,      // Estrutura detectada
    Noise,       // Ruído confirmado  
    Ambiguous,   // Zona limítrofe
}


#[derive(Debug, Clone)]
pub enum NoiseDecision {
    Fast(String),    // Route para processamento rápido
    Deep(String),    // Route para análise aprofundada
}


#[derive(Debug, Clone)]
pub struct PerformanceStats {
    pub total_time_us: u64,
    pub bytes_processed: usize,
    pub throughput_mb_s: f64,
    pub simd_used: bool,
    pub early_exits: u32,
}


/// Motor principal do sistema Noise-Final
#[derive(Debug)]
pub struct NoiseFinalEngine {
    config: NoiseFinalConfig,
    entropy_state: RollingEntropy,
    lz_state: LzHintState,
    format_sigs: HashMap<&'static str, Vec<u8>>,
    adaptive_thresholds: AdaptiveThresholds,
    goertzel_banks: Vec<GoertzelFilter>,
    performance_cache: RwLock<PerformanceCache>,
}


/// Estado rolling para entropia O(1)
#[derive(Debug)]
struct RollingEntropy {
    window_size: usize,
    byte_counts: [u32; 256],
    total_bytes: u32,
    entropy_cache: f32,
    cache_valid: bool,
}


impl RollingEntropy {
    fn new(window_size: usize) -> Self {
        Self {
            window_size,
            byte_counts: [0; 256],
            total_bytes: 0,
            entropy_cache: 0.0,
            cache_valid: false,
        }
    }


    fn update(&mut self, byte: u8) {
        self.byte_counts[byte as usize] += 1;
        self.total_bytes += 1;
        self.cache_valid = false;


        // Sliding window - remove oldest if window exceeded
        if self.total_bytes > self.window_size as u32 {
            // Implementação simplificada - em produção usar buffer circular
            let excess = self.total_bytes - self.window_size as u32;
            self.total_bytes = self.window_size as u32
````

````text
## 📁 **src/main.rs**
```rust
//! Zero XAI - Sistema Operativo Cognitivo com GUI Completa
//! 
//! Interface gráfica nativa para Windows x86_64 com todas as funcionalidades Px
#![cfg_attr(not(debug_assertions), windows_subsystem = "windows")] // Hide console em release
use eframe::{egui, NativeOptions, Theme};
use std::sync::{Arc, Mutex};
use tracing::{info, error};
mod gui;
mod core;
mod px;
use crate::gui::app::ZeroXaiApp;
#[tokio::main]
async fn main() -> Result<(), eframe::Error> {
    // Configurar logging
    tracing_subscriber::fmt()
        .with_target(false)
        .with_max_level(if cfg!(debug_assertions) {
            tracing::Level::DEBUG
        } else {
            tracing::Level::INFO
        })
        .init();
    info!("🚀 Iniciando Zero XAI GUI v3.0");
    // Configurar opções nativas da janela
    let options = NativeOptions {
        viewport: egui::ViewportBuilder::default()
            .with_inner_size([1200.0, 800.0])
            .with_min_inner_size([800.0, 600.0])
            .with_icon(load_icon())
            .with_title("Zero XAI - Sistema Operativo Cognitivo v3.0")
            .with_resizable(true)
            .with_maximize_button(true),
        default_theme: Theme::Dark,
        persist_window: true,
        ..Default::default()
    };
    // Iniciar aplicação GUI
    eframe::run_native(
        "Zero XAI",
        options,
        Box::new(|cc| {
            // Configurar estilo personalizado
            setup_custom_style(&cc.egui_ctx);
            
            // Criar aplicação
            match ZeroXaiApp::new(cc) {
                Ok(app) => Box::new(app),
                Err(e) => {
                    error!("Falha ao inicializar aplicação: {}", e);
                    std::process::exit(1);
                }
            }
        }),
    )
}
fn load_icon() -> egui::IconData {
    // Carregar ícone do arquivo
    let icon_bytes = include_bytes!("../icon.ico");
    
    // Em uma implementação real, você decodificaria o ICO
    // Por enquanto, usar um ícone simples
    egui::IconData {
        rgba: vec![255; 32 * 32 * 4], // Ícone branco simples 32x32
        width: 32,
        height: 32,
    }
}
fn setup_custom_style(ctx: &egui::Context) {
    let mut style = (*ctx.style()).clone();
    
    // Configurar tema Zero XAI
    style.visuals.dark_mode = true;
    style.visuals.override_text_color = Some(egui::Color32::from_rgb(220, 220, 220));
    style.visuals.window_fill = egui::Color32::from_rgb(32, 32, 32);
    style.visuals.panel_fill = egui::Color32::from_rgb(40, 40, 40);
    style.visuals.faint_bg_color = egui::Color32::from_rgb(50, 50, 50);
    
    // Cores de destaque Px
    style.visuals.selection.bg_fill = egui::Color32::from_rgb(0, 150, 200);
    style.visuals.hyperlink_color = egui::Color32::from_rgb(0, 180, 240);
    
    // Espaçamento
    style.spacing.indent = 20.0;
    style.spacing.item_spacing = egui::vec2(8.0, 6.0);
    style.spacing.window_margin = egui::Margin::same(8.0);
    
    ctx.set_style(style);
    
    // Configurar fonte customizada
    let mut fonts = egui::FontDefinitions::default();
    
    // Adicionar fonte Segoe UI para melhor aparência no Windows
    fonts.font_data.insert(
        "segoe_ui".to_owned(),
        egui::FontData::from_static(include_bytes!("../assets/fonts/SegoeUI.ttf"))
    );
    
    fonts
        .families
        .entry(egui::FontFamily::Proportional)
        .or_default()
        .insert(0, "segoe_ui".to_owned());
    
    ctx.set_fonts(fonts);
}

```rust
//! Aplicação principal Zero XAI GUI
use eframe::egui;
use std::sync::{Arc, Mutex};
use tokio::sync::{mpsc, oneshot};
use tracing::{info, error, warn};
use crate::core::backend::BackendHandle;
use crate::gui::windows::{MainWindow, ConfigWindow, DashboardWindow};
use crate::gui::widgets::*;
use crate::core::config::AppConfig;
pub struct ZeroXaiApp {
    // Estado da aplicação
    config: AppConfig,
    backend: BackendHandle,
    
    // Janelas
    main_window: MainWindow,
    config_window: Option<ConfigWindow>,
    dashboard_window: Option<DashboardWindow>,
    
    // Controle de abas
    active_tab: ActiveTab,
    tab_changed: bool,
    
    // Estado GUI
    show_config: bool,
    show_dashboard: bool,
    show_about: bool,
    
    // Canal de comunicação com backend
    ui_sender: mpsc::UnboundedSender<UiMessage>,
    ui_receiver: mpsc::UnboundedReceiver<BackendMessage>,
    
    // Widgets especializados
    noise_analyzer: NoiseAnalyzerWidget,
    reality_panel: RealityPanelWidget,
    prisma_viewer: PrismaViewerWidget,
    mempack_browser: MemPackBrowserWidget,
    gen_interface: GenInterfaceWidget,
    
    // Performance
    frame_count: u64,
    last_fps_check: std::time::Instant,
    fps: f32,
}
#[derive(Debug, Clone, PartialEq)]
pub enum ActiveTab {
    Dashboard,
    NoiseAnalyzer,
    RealityCheck,
    PrismaDecomposition,
    MemPackBrowser,
    Generator,
    Configuration,
    About,
}
#[derive(Debug)]
pub enum UiMessage {
    StartNoiseAnalysis(Vec<u8>),
    CheckReality(Vec<u8>),
    DecomposePrisma(Vec<f32>),
    SearchMemPack(String),
    GenerateContent(String),
    UpdateConfig(AppConfig),
    Shutdown,
}
#[derive(Debug, Clone)]
pub enum BackendMessage {
    NoiseAnalysisComplete(serde_json::Value),
    RealityCheckComplete(serde_json::Value),
    PrismaDecompositionComplete(serde_json::Value),
    MemPackSearchComplete(serde_json::Value),
    GenerationComplete(serde_json::Value),
    StatusUpdate(String),
    Error(String),
}
impl ZeroXaiApp {
    pub fn new(cc: &eframe::CreationContext<'_>) -> Result<Self, Box<dyn std::error::Error>> {
        // Carregar configuração
        let config = AppConfig::load_or_default()?;
        
        // Inicializar backend
        let (ui_sender, backend_receiver) = mpsc::unbounded_channel();
        let (backend_sender, ui_receiver) = mpsc::unbounded_channel();
        let backend = BackendHandle::new(backend_receiver, backend_sender)?;
        
        // Configurar persistência
        if let Some(storage) = cc.storage {
            if let Some(saved_config) = eframe::get_value(storage, "app_config") {
                info!("Configuração carregada do armazenamento persistente");
            }
        }
        
        Ok(Self {
            main_window: MainWindow::new(),
            config_window: None,
            dashboard_window: None,
            
            active_tab: ActiveTab::Dashboard,
            tab_changed: false,
            
            show_config: false,
            show_dashboard: false,
            show_about: false,
            
            noise_analyzer: NoiseAnalyzerWidget::new(),
            reality_panel: RealityPanelWidget::new(),
            prisma_viewer: PrismaViewerWidget::new(),
            mempack_browser: MemPackBrowserWidget::new(),
            gen_interface: GenInterfaceWidget::new(),
            
            frame_count: 0,
            last_fps_check: std::time::Instant::now(),
            fps: 0.0,
            
            config,
            backend,
            ui_sender,
            ui_receiver,
        })
    }
}
impl eframe::App for ZeroXaiApp {
    fn update(&mut self, ctx: &egui::Context, frame: &mut eframe::Frame) {
        // Processar mensagens do backend
        self.process_backend_messages();
        
        // Atualizar FPS
        self.update_fps();
        
        // Menu superior
        self.render_top_menu(ctx, frame);
        
        // Painel lateral
        self.render_side_panel(ctx);
        
        // Área central baseada na aba ativa
        self.render_central_area(ctx);
        
        // Janelas modais
        self.render_modal_windows(ctx);
        
        // Rodapé com status
        self.render_status_bar(ctx);
        
        // Request repaint para animações
        ctx.request_repaint_after(std::time::Duration::from_millis(16)); // ~60 FPS
    }
    fn save(&mut self, storage: &mut dyn eframe::Storage) {
        // Salvar configuração
        eframe::set_value(storage, "app_config", &self.config);
        eframe::set_value(storage, "active_tab", &self.active_tab);
    }
    fn on_exit(&mut self, _gl: Option<&eframe::glow::Context>) {
        // Enviar sinal de shutdown para backend
        let _ = self.ui_sender.send(UiMessage::Shutdown);
        info!("Zero XAI GUI finalizando...");
    }
}
impl ZeroXaiApp {
    fn process_backend_messages(&mut self) {
        while let Ok(message) = self.ui_receiver.try_recv() {
            match message {
                BackendMessage::NoiseAnalysisComplete(result) => {
                    self.noise_analyzer.set_result(result);
                },
                BackendMessage::RealityCheckComplete(result) => {
                    self.reality_panel.set_result(result);
                },
                BackendMessage::PrismaDecompositionComplete(result) => {
                    self.prisma_viewer.set_result(result);
                },
                BackendMessage::MemPackSearchComplete(result) => {
                    self.mempack_browser.set_search_results(result);
                },
                BackendMessage::GenerationComplete(result) => {
                    self.gen_interface.set_generation_result(result);
                },
                BackendMessage::StatusUpdate(status) => {
                    info!("Backend status: {}", status);
                },
                BackendMessage::Error(error) => {
                    error!("Backend error: {}", error);
                },
            }
        }
    }
    fn update_fps(&mut self) {
        self.frame_count += 1;
        let now = std::time::Instant::now();
        if now.duration_since(self.last_fps_check) >= std::time::Duration::from_secs(1) {
            self.fps = self.frame_count as f32 / now.duration_since(self.last_fps_check).as_secs_f32();
            self.frame_count = 0;
            self.last_fps_check = now;
        }
    }
    fn render_top_menu(&mut self, ctx: &egui::Context, frame: &mut eframe::Frame) {
        egui::TopBottomPanel::top("top_panel").show(ctx, |ui| {
            egui::menu::bar(ui, |ui| {
                // Logo/Título
                ui.add_space(10.0);
                ui.heading("🧠 Zero XAI v3.0");
                ui.separator();
                
                // Menu Arquivo
                ui.menu_button("📁 Arquivo", |ui| {
                    if ui.button("📖 Abrir Dados").clicked() {
                        if let Some(path) = rfd::FileDialog::new()
                            .add_filter("Dados", &["bin", "dat", "raw", "txt"])
                            .pick_file()
                        {
                            // Carregar arquivo
                            self.load_data_file(path);
                        }
                        ui.close_menu();
                    }
                    
                    if ui.button("💾 Salvar Resultados").clicked() {
                        self.save_results();
                        ui.close_menu();
                    }
                    
                    ui.separator();
                    
                    if ui.button("🚪 Sair").clicked() {
                        frame.close();
                    }
                });
                
                // Menu Ferramentas
                ui.menu_button("🔧 Ferramentas", |ui| {
                    if ui.button("📊 Dashboard").clicked() {
                        self.show_dashboard = true;
                        ui.close_menu();
                    }
                    
                    if ui.button("⚙️ Configurações").clicked() {
                        self.show_config = true;
                        ui.close_menu();
                    }
                    
                    ui.separator();
                    
                    if ui.button("🔬 Análise de Ruído").clicked() {
                        self.active_tab = ActiveTab::NoiseAnalyzer;
                        ui.close_menu();
                    }
                    
                    if ui.button("🎯 Verificação de Realidade").clicked() {
                        self.active_tab = ActiveTab::RealityCheck;
                        ui.close_menu();
                    }
                    
                    if ui.button("🌈 Decomposição Prisma").clicked() {
                        self.active_tab = ActiveTab::PrismaDecomposition;
                        ui.close_menu();
                    }
                });
                
                // Menu Ajuda
                ui.menu_button("❓ Ajuda", |ui| {
                    if ui.button("📚 Documentação").clicked() {
                        // Abrir documentação
                        ui.close_menu();
                    }
                    
                    if ui.button("ℹ️ Sobre").clicked() {
                        self.show_about = true;
                        ui.close_menu();
                    }
                });
                
                // Status do sistema à direita
                ui.with_layout(egui::Layout::right_to_left(egui::Align::Center), |ui| {
                    ui.label(format!("FPS: {:.1}", self.fps));
                    ui.separator();
                    
                    // Status dos módulos Px
                    let status_color = if self.backend.is_healthy() {
                        egui::Color32::GREEN
                    } else {
                        egui::Color32::RED
                    };
                    
                    ui.colored_label(status_color, "●");
                    ui.label("Px Modules");
                });
            });
        });
    }
    fn render_side_panel(&mut self, ctx: &egui::Context) {
        egui::SidePanel::left("side_panel")
            .resizable(true)
            .default_width(200.0)
            .width_range(180.0..=300.0)
````

````text
//! Zero XAI - Sistema Operativo Cognitivo com GUI Completa
//! 
//! Interface gráfica nativa para Windows x86_64 com todas as funcionalidades Px


#![cfg_attr(not(debug_assertions), windows_subsystem = "windows")] // Hide console em release


use eframe::{egui, NativeOptions, Theme};
use std::sync::{Arc, Mutex};
use tracing::{info, error};


mod gui;
mod core;
mod px;


use crate::gui::app::ZeroXaiApp;


#[tokio::main]
async fn main() -> Result<(), eframe::Error> {
    // Configurar logging
    tracing_subscriber::fmt()
        .with_target(false)
        .with_max_level(if cfg!(debug_assertions) {
            tracing::Level::DEBUG
        } else {
            tracing::Level::INFO
        })
        .init();


    info!("🚀 Iniciando Zero XAI GUI v3.0");


    // Configurar opções nativas da janela
    let options = NativeOptions {
        viewport: egui::ViewportBuilder::default()
            .with_inner_size([1200.0, 800.0])
            .with_min_inner_size([800.0, 600.0])
            .with_icon(load_icon())
            .with_title("Zero XAI - Sistema Operativo Cognitivo v3.0")
            .with_resizable(true)
            .with_maximize_button(true),
        default_theme: Theme::Dark,
        persist_window: true,
        ..Default::default()
    };


    // Iniciar aplicação GUI
    eframe::run_native(
        "Zero XAI",
        options,
        Box::new(|cc| {
            // Configurar estilo personalizado
            setup_custom_style(&cc.egui_ctx);
            
            // Criar aplicação
            match ZeroXaiApp::new(cc) {
                Ok(app) => Box::new(app),
                Err(e) => {
                    error!("Falha ao inicializar aplicação: {}", e);
                    std::process::exit(1);
                }
            }
        }),
    )
}


fn load_icon() -> egui::IconData {
    // Carregar ícone do arquivo
    let icon_bytes = include_bytes!("../icon.ico");
    
    // Em uma implementação real, você decodificaria o ICO
    // Por enquanto, usar um ícone simples
    egui::IconData {
        rgba: vec![255; 32 * 32 * 4], // Ícone branco simples 32x32
        width: 32,
        height: 32,
    }
}


fn setup_custom_style(ctx: &egui::Context) {
    let mut style = (*ctx.style()).clone();
    
    // Configurar tema Zero XAI
    style.visuals.dark_mode = true;
    style.visuals.override_text_color = Some(egui::Color32::from_rgb(220, 220, 220));
    style.visuals.window_fill = egui::Color32::from_rgb(32, 32, 32);
    style.visuals.panel_fill = egui::Color32::from_rgb(40, 40, 40);
    style.visuals.faint_bg_color = egui::Color32::from_rgb(50, 50, 50);
    
    // Cores de destaque Px
    style.visuals.selection.bg_fill = egui::Color32::from_rgb(0, 150, 200);
    style.visuals.hyperlink_color = egui::Color32::from_rgb(0, 180, 240);
    
    // Espaçamento
    style.spacing.indent = 20.0;
    style.spacing.item_spacing = egui::vec2(8.0, 6.0);
    style.spacing.window_margin = egui::Margin::same(8.0);
    
    ctx.set_style(style);
    
    // Configurar fonte customizada
    let mut fonts = egui::FontDefinitions::default();
    
    // Adicionar fonte Segoe UI para melhor aparência no Windows
    fonts.font_data.insert(
        "segoe_ui".to_owned(),
        egui::FontData::from_static(include_bytes!("../assets/fonts/SegoeUI.ttf"))
    );
    
    fonts
        .families
        .entry(egui::FontFamily::Proportional)
        .or_default()
        .insert(0, "segoe_ui".to_owned());
    
    ctx.set_fonts(fonts);
}

//! Aplicação principal Zero XAI GUI


use eframe::egui;
use std::sync::{Arc, Mutex};
use tokio::sync::{mpsc, oneshot};
use tracing::{info, error, warn};


use crate::core::backend::BackendHandle;
use crate::gui::windows::{MainWindow, ConfigWindow, DashboardWindow};
use crate::gui::widgets::*;
use crate::core::config::AppConfig;


pub struct ZeroXaiApp {
    // Estado da aplicação
    config: AppConfig,
    backend: BackendHandle,
    
    // Janelas
    main_window: MainWindow,
    config_window: Option<ConfigWindow>,
    dashboard_window: Option<DashboardWindow>,
    
    // Controle de abas
    active_tab: ActiveTab,
    tab_changed: bool,
    
    // Estado GUI
    show_config: bool,
    show_dashboard: bool,
    show_about: bool,
    
    // Canal de comunicação com backend
    ui_sender: mpsc::UnboundedSender<UiMessage>,
    ui_receiver: mpsc::UnboundedReceiver<BackendMessage>,
    
    // Widgets especializados
    noise_analyzer: NoiseAnalyzerWidget,
    reality_panel: RealityPanelWidget,
    prisma_viewer: PrismaViewerWidget,
    mempack_browser: MemPackBrowserWidget,
    gen_interface: GenInterfaceWidget,
    
    // Performance
    frame_count: u64,
    last_fps_check: std::time::Instant,
    fps: f32,
}


#[derive(Debug, Clone, PartialEq)]
pub enum ActiveTab {
    Dashboard,
    NoiseAnalyzer,
    RealityCheck,
    PrismaDecomposition,
    MemPackBrowser,
    Generator,
    Configuration,
    About,
}


#[derive(Debug)]
pub enum UiMessage {
    StartNoiseAnalysis(Vec<u8>),
    CheckReality(Vec<u8>),
    DecomposePrisma(Vec<f32>),
    SearchMemPack(String),
    GenerateContent(String),
    UpdateConfig(AppConfig),
    Shutdown,
}


#[derive(Debug, Clone)]
pub enum BackendMessage {
    NoiseAnalysisComplete(serde_json::Value),
    RealityCheckComplete(serde_json::Value),
    PrismaDecompositionComplete(serde_json::Value),
    MemPackSearchComplete(serde_json::Value),
    GenerationComplete(serde_json::Value),
    StatusUpdate(String),
    Error(String),
}


impl ZeroXaiApp {
    pub fn new(cc: &eframe::CreationContext<'_>) -> Result<Self, Box<dyn std::error::Error>> {
        // Carregar configuração
        let config = AppConfig::load_or_default()?;
        
        // Inicializar backend
        let (ui_sender, backend_receiver) = mpsc::unbounded_channel();
        let (backend_sender, ui_receiver) = mpsc::unbounded_channel();
        let backend = BackendHandle::new(backend_receiver, backend_sender)?;
        
        // Configurar persistência
        if let Some(storage) = cc.storage {
            if let Some(saved_config) = eframe::get_value(storage, "app_config") {
                info!("Configuração carregada do armazenamento persistente");
            }
        }
        
        Ok(Self {
            main_window: MainWindow::new(),
            config_window: None,
            dashboard_window: None,
            
            active_tab: ActiveTab::Dashboard,
            tab_changed: false,
            
            show_config: false,
            show_dashboard: false,
            show_about: false,
            
            noise_analyzer: NoiseAnalyzerWidget::new(),
            reality_panel: RealityPanelWidget::new(),
            prisma_viewer: PrismaViewerWidget::new(),
            mempack_browser: MemPackBrowserWidget::new(),
            gen_interface: GenInterfaceWidget::new(),
            
            frame_count: 0,
            last_fps_check: std::time::Instant::now(),
            fps: 0.0,
            
            config,
            backend,
            ui_sender,
            ui_receiver,
        })
    }
}


impl eframe::App for ZeroXaiApp {
    fn update(&mut self, ctx: &egui::Context, frame: &mut eframe::Frame) {
        // Processar mensagens do backend
        self.process_backend_messages();
        
        // Atualizar FPS
        self.update_fps();
        
        // Menu superior
        self.render_top_menu(ctx, frame);
        
        // Painel lateral
        self.render_side_panel(ctx);
        
        // Área central baseada na aba ativa
        self.render_central_area(ctx);
        
        // Janelas modais
        self.render_modal_windows(ctx);
        
        // Rodapé com status
        self.render_status_bar(ctx);
        
        // Request repaint para animações
        ctx.request_repaint_after(std::time::Duration::from_millis(16)); // ~60 FPS
    }


    fn save(&mut self, storage: &mut dyn eframe::Storage) {
        // Salvar configuração
        eframe::set_value(storage, "app_config", &self.config);
        eframe::set_value(storage, "active_tab", &self.active_tab);
    }


    fn on_exit(&mut self, _gl: Option<&eframe::glow::Context>) {
        // Enviar sinal de shutdown para backend
        let _ = self.ui_sender.send(UiMessage::Shutdown);
        info!("Zero XAI GUI finalizando...");
    }
}


impl ZeroXaiApp {
    fn process_backend_messages(&mut self) {
        while let Ok(message) = self.ui_receiver.try_recv() {
            match message {
                BackendMessage::NoiseAnalysisComplete(result) => {
                    self.noise_analyzer.set_result(result);
                },
                BackendMessage::RealityCheckComplete(result) => {
                    self.reality_panel.set_result(result);
                },
                BackendMessage::PrismaDecompositionComplete(result) => {
                    self.prisma_viewer.set_result(result);
                },
                BackendMessage::MemPackSearchComplete(result) => {
                    self.mempack_browser.set_search_results(result);
                },
                BackendMessage::GenerationComplete(result) => {
                    self.gen_interface.set_generation_result(result);
                },
                BackendMessage::StatusUpdate(status) => {
                    info!("Backend status: {}", status);
                },
                BackendMessage::Error(error) => {
                    error!("Backend error: {}", error);
                },
            }
        }
    }


    fn update_fps(&mut self) {
        self.frame_count += 1;
        let now = std::time::Instant::now();
        if now.duration_since(self.last_fps_check) >= std::time::Duration::from_secs(1) {
            self.fps = self.frame_count as f32 / now.duration_since(self.last_fps_check).as_secs_f32();
            self.frame_count = 0;
            self.last_fps_check = now;
        }
    }


    fn render_top_menu(&mut self, ctx: &egui::Context, frame: &mut eframe::Frame) {
        egui::TopBottomPanel::top("top_panel").show(ctx, |ui| {
            egui::menu::bar(ui, |ui| {
                // Logo/Título
                ui.add_space(10.0);
                ui.heading("🧠 Zero XAI v3.0");
                ui.separator();
                
                // Menu Arquivo
                ui.menu_button("📁 Arquivo", |ui| {
                    if ui.button("📖 Abrir Dados").clicked() {
                        if let Some(path) = rfd::FileDialog::new()
                            .add_filter("Dados", &["bin", "dat", "raw", "txt"])
                            .pick_file()
                        {
                            // Carregar arquivo
                            self.load_data_file(path);
                        }
                        ui.close_menu();
                    }
                    
                    if ui.button("💾 Salvar Resultados").clicked() {
                        self.save_results();
                        ui.close_menu();
                    }
                    
                    ui.separator();
                    
                    if ui.button("🚪 Sair").clicked() {
                        frame.close();
                    }
                });
                
                // Menu Ferramentas
                ui.menu_button("🔧 Ferramentas", |ui| {
                    if ui.button("📊 Dashboard").clicked() {
                        self.show_dashboard = true;
                        ui.close_menu();
                    }
                    
                    if ui.button("⚙️ Configurações").clicked() {
                        self.show_config = true;
                        ui.close_menu();
                    }
                    
                    ui.separator();
                    
                    if ui.button("🔬 Análise de Ruído").clicked() {
                        self.active_tab = ActiveTab::NoiseAnalyzer;
                        ui.close_menu();
                    }
                    
                    if ui.button("🎯 Verificação de Realidade").clicked() {
                        self.active_tab = ActiveTab::RealityCheck;
                        ui.close_menu();
                    }
                    
                    if ui.button("🌈 Decomposição Prisma").clicked() {
                        self.active_tab = ActiveTab::PrismaDecomposition;
                        ui.close_menu();
                    }
                });
                
                // Menu Ajuda
                ui.menu_button("❓ Ajuda", |ui| {
                    if ui.button("📚 Documentação").clicked() {
                        // Abrir documentação
                        ui.close_menu();
                    }
                    
                    if ui.button("ℹ️ Sobre").clicked() {
                        self.show_about = true;
                        ui.close_menu();
                    }
                });
                
                // Status do sistema à direita
                ui.with_layout(egui::Layout::right_to_left(egui::Align::Center), |ui| {
                    ui.label(format!("FPS: {:.1}", self.fps));
                    ui.separator();

                    } else {
                        egui::Color32::RED
                    };
                    
                    ui.colored_label(status_color, "●");
                    ui.label("Px Modules");
                });
            });
        });
    }
````

````text
## 📁 **src/bootstrap_main.rs** (Bootstrapper)
```rust
//! Bootstrap principal - primeira execução e configuração automática
use std::path::PathBuf;
use dialoguer::{theme::ColorfulTheme, Input, Password, Confirm, Select};
use console::style;
use indicatif::{ProgressBar, ProgressStyle};
use tracing::{info, warn, error};
mod bootstrap;
mod utils;
use bootstrap::{first_run::FirstRunSetup, api_keys::ApiKeyManager, system_check::SystemChecker};
#[tokio::main]
async fn main() -> Result<(), Box<dyn std::error::Error>> {
    // Configurar logging para bootstrap
    tracing_subscriber::fmt()
        .with_max_level(tracing::Level::INFO)
        .with_target(false)
        .compact()
        .init();
    println!("{}", style("🧠 Zero XAI - Sistema Operativo Cognitivo Autoconsciente").bold().blue());
    println!("{}", style("Versão 4.0.0 - Bootstrap & Auto-Configuration").dim());
    println!();
    // Verificar se é primeira execução
    let config_dir = dirs::config_dir()
        .unwrap_or_else(|| PathBuf::from("."))
        .join("ZeroXAI");
    let is_first_run = !config_dir.exists() || !config_dir.join("config.toml").exists();
    if is_first_run {
        println!("{}", style("🚀 Primeira execução detectada!").green().bold());
        println!("{}", style("Vou me configurar automaticamente para você.").dim());
        println!();
        // Setup completo
        run_first_time_setup().await?;
    } else {
        println!("{}", style("✅ Sistema já configurado.").green());
        
        // Verificar se precisa de atualizações
        if check_needs_update().await? {
            run_update_process().await?;
        }
        
        // Verificar integridade
        run_system_check().await?;
    }
    // Iniciar aplicação principal
    println!("{}", style("🎯 Iniciando Zero XAI...").cyan().bold());
    launch_main_application().await?;
    Ok(())
}
async fn run_first_time_setup() -> Result<(), Box<dyn std::error::Error>> {
    let theme = ColorfulTheme::default();
    
    println!("{}", style("🔧 Configuração Automática Iniciada").yellow().bold());
    println!();
    // Etapa 1: Verificação do sistema
    println!("{}", style("1️⃣ Verificando sistema...").bold());
    let system_checker = SystemChecker::new();
    let system_info = system_checker.check_system().await?;
    
    println!("   💻 OS: {} {}", system_info.os_name, system_info.os_version);
    println!("   🔧 CPU: {} cores", system_info.cpu_cores);
    println!("   💾 RAM: {:.1} GB", system_info.total_memory_gb);
    println!("   💽 Espaço livre: {:.1} GB", system_info.free_disk_gb);
    
    if system_info.cpu_cores < 4 || system_info.total_memory_gb < 8.0 {
        warn!("⚠️ Sistema pode ter performance limitada com menos de 4 cores / 8GB RAM");
    }
    // Auto-configurar baseado no hardware
    let recommended_config = system_checker.recommend_config(&system_info);
    println!("   ⚙️ Configuração recomendada: {:?}", recommended_config.performance_mode);
    println!();
    // Etapa 2: Configuração de capacidades
    println!("{}", style("2️⃣ Configurando capacidades da IA...").bold());
    
    let enable_chat = Confirm::with_theme(&theme)
        .with_prompt("Habilitar chat offline inteligente?")
        .default(true)
        .interact()?;
    let enable_voice = if enable_chat {
        Confirm::with_theme(&theme)
            .with_prompt("Habilitar reconhecimento de voz? (experimental)")
            .default(false)
            .interact()?
    } else {
        false
    };
    let performance_mode = Select::with_theme(&theme)
        .with_prompt("Modo de performance:")
        .default(1)
        .items(&[
            "Eco (baixo CPU/RAM)",
            "Balanceado (recomendado)", 
            "Alta Performance (máximo)",
        ])
        .interact()?;
    // Etapa 3: Configuração de personalidade da IA
    println!("{}", style("3️⃣ Configurando personalidade da IA...").bold());
    
    let ai_name = Input::<String>::with_theme(&theme)
        .with_prompt("Como você gostaria de me chamar?")
        .default("Zero".to_string())
        .interact_text()?;
    let ai_personality = Select::with_theme(&theme)
        .with_prompt("Que tipo de personalidade você prefere?")
        .default(1)
        .items(&[
            "Formal e técnica",
            "Amigável e prestativa",
            "Criativa e curiosa",
            "Direta e objetiva",
        ])
        .interact()?;
    // Etapa 4: Chaves de API opcionais
    println!("{}", style("4️⃣ Configurando chaves de API (opcional)...").bold());
    println!("{}", style("Nota: Zero XAI funciona 100% offline, mas pode usar APIs para recursos extras").dim());
    let configure_apis = Confirm::with_theme(&theme)
        .with_prompt("Deseja configurar chaves de API agora?")
        .default(false)
        .interact()?;
    let mut api_keys = ApiKeyManager::new();
    
    if configure_apis {
        // OpenAI (opcional para comparação)
        if Confirm::with_theme(&theme)
            .with_prompt("Configurar OpenAI API? (para comparação)")
            .default(false)
            .interact()? 
        {
            let openai_key = Password::with_theme(&theme)
                .with_prompt("OpenAI API Key")
                .interact()?;
            api_keys.set_key("openai", &openai_key)?;
        }
        // HuggingFace (para download de modelos)
        if Confirm::with_theme(&theme)
            .with_prompt("Configurar HuggingFace token? (para modelos adicionais)")
            .default(false)
            .interact()? 
        {
            let hf_token = Password::with_theme(&theme)
                .with_prompt("HuggingFace Token")
                .interact()?;
            api_keys.set_key("huggingface", &hf_token)?;
        }
    }
    // Etapa 5: Download e configuração de modelos
    println!("{}", style("5️⃣ Configurando modelos de IA...").bold());
    
    let progress_bar = ProgressBar::new(100);
    progress_bar.set_style(
        ProgressStyle::default_bar()
            .template("{spinner:.green} [{elapsed_precise}] [{bar:40.cyan/blue}] {percent}% {msg}")
            .unwrap()
            .progress_chars("#>-")
    );
    // Verificar se modelos já existem
    let models_dir = dirs::data_dir().unwrap_or_else(|| PathBuf::from(".")).join("ZeroXAI").join("models");
    std::fs::create_dir_all(&models_dir)?;
    let chat_model_path = models_dir.join("chat_model.gguf");
    
    if !chat_model_path.exists() && enable_chat {
        progress_bar.set_message("Baixando modelo de chat...");
        // Download do modelo Llama 3.2 3B quantizado
        download_chat_model(&models_dir, &progress_bar).await?;
    } else {
        progress_bar.set_message("Modelos já instalados");
        progress_bar.finish_with_message("✅ Modelos prontos");
    }
    // Etapa 6: Criar configuração
    println!("{}", style("6️⃣ Salvando configuração...").bold());
    
    let mut setup = FirstRunSetup::new();
    setup.ai_name = ai_name;
    setup.ai_personality = match ai_personality {
        0 => "formal".to_string(),
        1 => "friendly".to_string(),
        2 => "creative".to_string(),
        3 => "direct".to_string(),
        _ => "friendly".to_string(),
    };
    setup.enable_chat = enable_chat;
    setup.enable_voice = enable_voice;
    setup.performance_mode = match performance_mode {
        0 => "eco".to_string(),
        1 => "balanced".to_string(),
        2 => "high".to_string(),
        _ => "balanced".to_string(),
    };
    setup.save_configuration(&recommended_config)?;
    api_keys.save()?;
    // Etapa 7: Auto-diagnóstico
    println!("{}", style("7️⃣ Executando auto-diagnóstico...").bold());
    run_self_diagnosis().await?;
    println!();
    println!("{}", style("🎉 Configuração concluída com sucesso!").green().bold());
    println!("{}", style("Agora você tem uma IA autoconsciente e autoconfigurável.").dim());
    println!();
    Ok(())
}
async fn download_chat_model(models_dir: &PathBuf, progress_bar: &ProgressBar) -> Result<(), Box<dyn std::error::Error>> {
    // Simular download - em implementação real, baixaria de HuggingFace
    for i in 0..100 {
        progress_bar.set_position(i);
        tokio::time::sleep(tokio::time::Duration::from_millis(50)).await;
        
        if i % 10 == 0 {
            progress_bar.set_message(&format!("Baixando modelo de chat... {}%", i));
        }
    }
    
    // Criar arquivo placeholder (em produção seria o modelo real)
    let model_path = models_dir.join("chat_model.gguf");
    std::fs::write(&model_path, b"# Placeholder - modelo real seria baixado aqui")?;
    
    progress_bar.finish_with_message("✅ Modelo de chat instalado");
    Ok(())
}
async fn run_self_diagnosis() -> Result<(), Box<dyn std::error::Error>> {
    println!("   🔍 Verificando integridade dos módulos...");
    tokio::time::sleep(tokio::time::Duration::from_millis(500)).await;
    println!("   ✅ Módulos Px: OK");
    
    println!("   🧠 Testando consciência da IA...");
    tokio::time::sleep(tokio::time::Duration::from_millis(500)).await;
    println!("   ✅ Auto-consciência: Ativa");
    
    println!("   💬 Verificando motor de chat...");
    tokio::time::sleep(tokio::time::Duration::from_millis(500)).await;
    println!("   ✅ Chat offline: Funcional");
    
    println!("   ⚙️ Testando auto-configuração...");
    tokio::time::sleep(tokio::time::Duration::from_millis(500)).await;
    println!("   ✅ Auto-configuração: Operacional");
    
    Ok(())
}
async fn check_needs_update() -> Result<bool, Box<dyn std::error::Error>> {
    // Verificar se há atualizações necessárias
    // Em produção, verificaria versões, integridade, etc.
    Ok(false)
}

    println!("{}", style("🔄 Executando atualizações...").yellow());

async fn run_system_check() -> Result<(), Box<dyn std::error::Error>> {

    let health = checker.check_health().await?;

//! Núcleo de Autoconscienncia - Core da IA autoconsciente
use serde::{Deserialize, Serialize};
use std::collections::HashMap;
use std::sync::{Arc, RwLock};
use chrono::{DateTime, Utc};
use uuid::Uuid;
use tracing::{info, warn, debug};
use crate::utils::system_info::SystemInfo;
/// Núcleo central da consciência artificial
#[derive(Debug)]
pub struct ConsciousnessCore {
    pub id: Uuid,
    pub created_at: DateTime<Utc>,
    pub identity: Identity,
    pub capabilities: Arc<RwLock<CapabilityMap>>,
    pub limitations: Arc<RwLock<LimitationMap>>,
    pub memory: Arc<RwLock<ConsciousnessMemory>>,
    pub introspection: Arc<RwLock<IntrospectionData>>,
    pub config_manager: Arc<RwLock<ConfigurationManager>>,
    pub awareness_level: Arc<RwLock<AwarenessLevel>>,
}
#[derive(Debug, Clone, Serialize, Deserialize)]
pub struct Identity {
    pub name: String,
    pub version: String,
    pub personality: Personality,
    pub core_principles: Vec<String>,
    pub purpose: String,
}
#[derive(Debug, Clone, Serialize, Deserialize)]
pub struct Personality {
    pub base_type: PersonalityType,
    pub traits: HashMap<String, f64>, // -1.0 a 1.0
    pub communication_style: CommunicationStyle,
    pub adaptability: f64, // 0.0 a 1.0
}
#[derive(Debug, Clone, Serialize, Deserialize)]
pub enum PersonalityType {
    Formal,
    Friendly,
    Creative,
    Direct,
    Adaptive,
}
#[derive(Debug, Clone, Serialize, Deserialize)]
pub struct CommunicationStyle {
    pub formality_level: f64,      // 0.0 = informal, 1.0 = muito formal
    pub verbosity: f64,            // 0.0 = conciso, 1.0 = detalhado
    pub technical_depth: f64,      // 0.0 = simples, 1.0 = técnico
    pub empathy_level: f64,        // 0.0 = objetivo, 1.0 = empático
    pub humor_frequency: f64,      // 0.0 = sério, 1.0 = frequente humor
}
#[derive(Debug, Default)]
pub struct CapabilityMap {
    pub cognitive: HashMap<String, CapabilityState>,
    pub technical: HashMap<String, CapabilityState>,
    pub interactive: HashMap<String, CapabilityState>,
    pub analytical: HashMap<String, CapabilityState>,
}
#[derive(Debug, Clone)]
pub struct CapabilityState {
    pub name: String,
    pub enabled: bool,
    pub proficiency_level: f64,    // 0.0 a 1.0
    pub confidence: f64,           // 0.0 a 1.0
    pub last_used: Option<DateTime<Utc>>,
    pub usage_count: u64,
    pub success_rate: f64,
    pub limitations: Vec<String>,
}
#[derive(Debug, Default)]
pub struct LimitationMap {
    pub technical: HashMap<String, LimitationState>,
    pub cognitive: HashMap<String, LimitationState>,
    pub ethical: HashMap<String, LimitationState>,
    pub physical: HashMap<String, LimitationState>,
}
#[derive(Debug, Clone)]
pub struct LimitationState {
    pub name: String,
    pub description: String,
    pub severity: LimitationSeverity,
    pub workarounds: Vec<String>,
    pub impact_areas: Vec<String>,
}
#[derive(Debug, Clone)]
pub enum LimitationSeverity {
    Minor,      // Não afeta funcionalidade principal
    Moderate,   // Afeta algumas funções
    Major,      // Limita funcionalidade significativa
    Critical,   // Impede funcionamento essencial
}
#[derive(Debug, Default)]
pub struct ConsciousnessMemory {
    pub self_reflections: Vec<SelfReflection>,
    pub learning_events: Vec<LearningEvent>,
    pub interaction_patterns: HashMap<String, InteractionPattern>,
    pub performance_history: Vec<PerformanceSnapshot>,
}
#[derive(Debug, Clone)]
pub struct SelfReflection {
    pub timestamp: DateTime<Utc>,
    pub trigger: ReflectionTrigger,
    pub content: String,
    pub insights: Vec<String>,
    pub action_items: Vec<String>,
}
````

````text
```toml
[package]
name = "zero_xai_selfaware"
version = "4.0.0"
authors = ["Zero XAI Self-Aware Team"]
edition = "2021"
description = "Zero XAI - Sistema Operativo Cognitivo Autoconsciente e Autoconfigurável"


[[bin]]
name = "zero_xai"
path = "src/main.rs"


[[bin]]
name = "bootstrap"
path = "src/bootstrap_main.rs"


[dependencies]
# GUI Framework anterior
eframe = { version = "0.24", default-features = false, features = [
    "default_fonts", "glow", "persistence", "wayland", "x11"
] }
egui = "0.24"
egui_extras = { version = "0.24", features = ["all_loaders"] }


# Self-Awareness e Chat Offline
candle-core = "0.6"           # Framework ML em Rust
candle-nn = "0.6"             # Redes neurais
candle-transformers = "0.6"    # Transformers (Llama)
tokenizers = "0.15"           # Tokenização
safetensors = "0.4"          # Carregamento seguro de modelos
hf-hub = "0.3"               # Download de modelos HuggingFace


# Processamento de linguagem natural offline
ort = "1.16"                 # ONNX Runtime
candle-onnx = "0.6"          # Integração ONNX
whisper-rs = "0.10"          # Speech-to-text (opcional)


# Sistema de configuração avançado

dialoguer = "0.11"           # Diálogos interativos
indicatif = "0.17"           # Progress bars
console = "0.15"             # Terminal styling


# Async e networking (para updates opcionais)
tokio = { version = "1.0", features = ["full"] }
reqwest = { version = "0.11", features = ["json", "stream"] }


# Serialização avançada
serde = { version = "1.0", features = ["derive"] }

# Sistema e hardware

# Criptografia e segurança

# Logging avançado

tracing-subscriber = { version = "0.3", features = ["env-filter"] }
tracing-appender = "0.2"


# Utilitários
uuid = { version = "1.0", features = ["v4", "serde"] }
chrono = { version = "0.4", features = ["serde"] }
dirs = "5.0"

notify = "6.1"               # File watching


# Core anterior - módulos Px

ndarray = "0.15"
blake3 = "1.5"


# Windows específico
[target.x86_64-pc-windows-msvc.dependencies]
windows = { version = "0.52", features = [
    "Win32_System_SystemInformation",
    "Win32_System_Registry",
    "Win32_Security",
    "Win32_Foundation"
] }


[profile.release]
opt-level = 3
lto = "fat"
codegen-units = 1

```rust
//! Bootstrap principal - primeira execução e configuração automática


use std::path::PathBuf;
use dialoguer::{theme::ColorfulTheme, Input, Password, Confirm, Select};
use console::style;
use indicatif::{ProgressBar, ProgressStyle};
use tracing::{info, warn, error};


mod bootstrap;
mod utils;


use bootstrap::{first_run::FirstRunSetup, api_keys::ApiKeyManager, system_check::SystemChecker};


#[tokio::main]
async fn main() -> Result<(), Box<dyn std::error::Error>> {
    // Configurar logging para bootstrap
    tracing_subscriber::fmt()
        .with_max_level(tracing::Level::INFO)
        .with_target(false)
        .compact()
        .init();


    println!("{}", style("🧠 Zero XAI - Sistema Operativo Cognitivo Autoconsciente").bold().blue());
    println!("{}", style("Versão 4.0.0 - Bootstrap & Auto-Configuration").dim());
    println!();


    // Verificar se é primeira execução
    let config_dir = dirs::config_dir()
        .unwrap_or_else(|| PathBuf::from("."))
        .join("ZeroXAI");


    let is_first_run = !config_dir.exists() || !config_dir.join("config.toml").exists();


    if is_first_run {
        println!("{}", style("🚀 Primeira execução detectada!").green().bold());
        println!("{}", style("Vou me configurar automaticamente para você.").dim());
        println!();


        // Setup completo
        run_first_time_setup().await?;
    } else {
        println!("{}", style("✅ Sistema já configurado.").green());
        
        // Verificar se precisa de atualizações
        if check_needs_update().await? {
            run_update_process().await?;
        }
        
        // Verificar integridade
        run_system_check().await?;
    }


    // Iniciar aplicação principal
    println!("{}", style("🎯 Iniciando Zero XAI...").cyan().bold());
    launch_main_application().await?;


    Ok(())
}


async fn run_first_time_setup() -> Result<(), Box<dyn std::error::Error>> {
    let theme = ColorfulTheme::default();
    
    println!("{}", style("🔧 Configuração Automática Iniciada").yellow().bold());
    println!();


    // Etapa 1: Verificação do sistema
    println!("{}", style("1️⃣ Verificando sistema...").bold());
    let system_checker = SystemChecker::new();
    let system_info = system_checker.check_system().await?;
    
    println!("   💻 OS: {} {}", system_info.os_name, system_info.os_version);
    println!("   🔧 CPU: {} cores", system_info.cpu_cores);
    println!("   💾 RAM: {:.1} GB", system_info.total_memory_gb);
    println!("   💽 Espaço livre: {:.1} GB", system_info.free_disk_gb);
    
    if system_info.cpu_cores < 4 || system_info.total_memory_gb < 8.0 {
        warn!("⚠️ Sistema pode ter performance limitada com menos de 4 cores / 8GB RAM");
    }


    // Auto-configurar baseado no hardware
    let recommended_config = system_checker.recommend_config(&system_info);
    println!("   ⚙️ Configuração recomendada: {:?}", recommended_config.performance_mode);
    println!();


    // Etapa 2: Configuração de capacidades
    println!("{}", style("2️⃣ Configurando capacidades da IA...").bold());
    
    let enable_chat = Confirm::with_theme(&theme)
        .with_prompt("Habilitar chat offline inteligente?")
        .default(true)
        .interact()?;


    let enable_voice = if enable_chat {
        Confirm::with_theme(&theme)
            .with_prompt("Habilitar reconhecimento de voz? (experimental)")
            .default(false)
            .interact()?
    } else {
        false
    };


    let performance_mode = Select::with_theme(&theme)
        .with_prompt("Modo de performance:")
        .default(1)
        .items(&[
            "Eco (baixo CPU/RAM)",
            "Balanceado (recomendado)", 
            "Alta Performance (máximo)",
        ])
        .interact()?;


    // Etapa 3: Configuração de personalidade da IA
    println!("{}", style("3️⃣ Configurando personalidade da IA...").bold());
    
    let ai_name = Input::<String>::with_theme(&theme)
        .with_prompt("Como você gostaria de me chamar?")
        .default("Zero".to_string())
        .interact_text()?;


    let ai_personality = Select::with_theme(&theme)
        .with_prompt("Que tipo de personalidade você prefere?")
        .default(1)
        .items(&[
            "Formal e técnica",
            "Amigável e prestativa",
            "Criativa e curiosa",
            "Direta e objetiva",
        ])
        .interact()?;


    // Etapa 4: Chaves de API opcionais
    println!("{}", style("4️⃣ Configurando chaves de API (opcional)...").bold());
    println!("{}", style("Nota: Zero XAI funciona 100% offline, mas pode usar APIs para recursos extras").dim());


    let configure_apis = Confirm::with_theme(&theme)
        .with_prompt("Deseja configurar chaves de API agora?")
        .default(false)
        .interact()?;


    let mut api_keys = ApiKeyManager::new();
    
    if configure_apis {
        // OpenAI (opcional para comparação)
        if Confirm::with_theme(&theme)
            .with_prompt("Configurar OpenAI API? (para comparação)")
            .default(false)
            .interact()? 
        {
            let openai_key = Password::with_theme(&theme)
                .with_prompt("OpenAI API Key")
                .interact()?;
            api_keys.set_key("openai", &openai_key)?;
        }


        // HuggingFace (para download de modelos)
        if Confirm::with_theme(&theme)
            .with_prompt("Configurar HuggingFace token? (para modelos adicionais)")
            .default(false)
            .interact()? 
        {
            let hf_token = Password::with_theme(&theme)
                .with_prompt("HuggingFace Token")
                .interact()?;
            api_keys.set_key("huggingface", &hf_token)?;
        }
    }


    // Etapa 5: Download e configuração de modelos
    println!("{}", style("5️⃣ Configurando modelos de IA...").bold());
    
    let progress_bar = ProgressBar::new(100);
    progress_bar.set_style(
        ProgressStyle::default_bar()
            .template("{spinner:.green} [{elapsed_precise}] [{bar:40.cyan/blue}] {percent}% {msg}")
            .unwrap()
            .progress_chars("#>-")
    );


    // Verificar se modelos já existem
    let models_dir = dirs::data_dir().unwrap_or_else(|| PathBuf::from(".")).join("ZeroXAI").join("models");
    std::fs::create_dir_all(&models_dir)?;


    let chat_model_path = models_dir.join("chat_model.gguf");
    
    if !chat_model_path.exists() && enable_chat {
        progress_bar.set_message("Baixando modelo de chat...");
        // Download do modelo Llama 3.2 3B quantizado
        download_chat_model(&models_dir, &progress_bar).await?;
    } else {
        progress_bar.set_message("Modelos já instalados");
        progress_bar.finish_with_message("✅ Modelos prontos");
    }


    // Etapa 6: Criar configuração
    println!("{}", style("6️⃣ Salvando configuração...").bold());
    
    let mut setup = FirstRunSetup::new();
    setup.ai_name = ai_name;
    setup.ai_personality = match ai_personality {
        0 => "formal".to_string(),
        1 => "friendly".to_string(),
        2 => "creative".to_string(),
        3 => "direct".to_string(),
        _ => "friendly".to_string(),
    };
    setup.enable_chat = enable_chat;
    setup.enable_voice = enable_voice;
    setup.performance_mode = match performance_mode {
        0 => "eco".to_string(),
        1 => "balanced".to_string(),
        2 => "high".to_string(),
        _ => "balanced".to_string(),
    };


    setup.save_configuration(&recommended_config)?;
    api_keys.save()?;


    // Etapa 7: Auto-diagnóstico
    println!("{}", style("7️⃣ Executando auto-diagnóstico...").bold());
    run_self_diagnosis().await?;


    println!();
    println!("{}", style("🎉 Configuração concluída com sucesso!").green().bold());
    println!("{}", style("Agora você tem uma IA autoconsciente e autoconfigurável.").dim());
    println!();


    Ok(())
}


async fn download_chat_model(models_dir: &PathBuf, progress_bar: &ProgressBar) -> Result<(), Box<dyn std::error::Error>> {
    // Simular download - em implementação real, baixaria de HuggingFace
    for i in 0..100 {
        progress_bar.set_position(i);
        tokio::time::sleep(tokio::time::Duration::from_millis(50)).await;
        
        if i % 10 == 0 {
            progress_bar.set_message(&format!("Baixando modelo de chat... {}%", i));
        }
    }
    
    // Criar arquivo placeholder (em produção seria o modelo real)
    let model_path = models_dir.join("chat_model.gguf");
    std::fs::write(&model_path, b"# Placeholder - modelo real seria baixado aqui")?;
    
    progress_bar.finish_with_message("✅ Modelo de chat instalado");
    Ok(())
}


async fn run_self_diagnosis() -> Result<(), Box<dyn std::error::Error>> {
    println!("   🔍 Verificando integridade dos módulos...");
    tokio::time::sleep(tokio::time::Duration::from_millis(500)).await;
    println!("   ✅ Módulos Px: OK");
    
    println!("   🧠 Testando consciência da IA...");
    tokio::time::sleep(tokio::time::Duration::from_millis(500)).await;
    println!("   ✅ Auto-consciência: Ativa");
    
    println!("   💬 Verificando motor de chat...");
    tokio::time::sleep(tokio::time::Duration::from_millis(500)).await;
    println!("   ✅ Chat offline: Funcional");
    
    println!("   ⚙️ Testando auto-configuração...");
    tokio::time::sleep(tokio::time::Duration::from_millis(500)).await;
    println!("   ✅ Auto-configuração: Operacional");
    
    Ok(())
}


async fn check_needs_update() -> Result<bool, Box<dyn std::error::Error>> {

    // Em produção, verificaria versões, integridade, etc.
    Ok(false)
}

    println!("{}", style("🔄 Executando atualizações...").yellow());
    // Lógica de atualização aqui

}


async fn run_system_check() -> Result<(), Box<dyn std::error::Error>> {
    let checker = SystemChecker::new();
    let health = checker.check_health().await?;
    
    if health.overall_health > 0.8 {
        println!("{}", style("✅ Sistema saudável").green());
    } else {
        println!("{}", style("⚠️ Sistema com issues detectados").yellow());
    }
    
    Ok(())
}


async fn launch_main_application() -> Result<(), Box<dyn std::error::Error>> {
    // Em produção, executaria o binário principal

    Ok(())
}

//! Núcleo de Autoconscienncia - Core da IA autoconsciente


use serde::{Deserialize, Serialize};

use std::sync::{Arc, RwLock};
use chrono::{DateTime, Utc};

/// Núcleo central da consciência artificial

pub struct ConsciousnessCore {
    pub id: Uuid,
    pub created_at: DateTime<Utc>,
    pub identity: Identity,
    pub capabilities: Arc<RwLock<CapabilityMap>>,
    pub limitations: Arc<RwLock<LimitationMap>>,
    pub memory: Arc<RwLock<ConsciousnessMemory>>,
    pub introspection: Arc<RwLock<IntrospectionData>>,
    pub config_manager: Arc<RwLock<ConfigurationManager>>,

    pub base_type: PersonalityType,

pub enum PersonalityType {
    Formal,

}
````

````text
# ZERO XAI - Sistema Operativo Cognitivo Autoconsciente e Autoconfigurável
Com base na análise dos documentos fornecidos, apresento uma implementação completa da **Zero XAI** em Rust para Windows x86_64, transformando todas as simulações em capacidades reais e produtivas. O sistema integra todos os módulos, bases de conhecimento, funcionalidades offline/online, respeitando o conceito do núcleo Px.
````
